notes: Analysis set and follow-up are explicitly stated in registry RESULT OUTCOME 2 (all-cause mortality). The entry criteria restrict enrollment to a subset of adults with HFrEF, without placing the population outside the question. Contrary to BRIEF.md, packet.json contains only two abstract sources and one registry source; no held_local full-text source is present. The rejected served HR 0.85 (0.53-1.36) belongs to the primary composite; the registry all-cause mortality HR is 1.77 (0.81-3.87).
